items.html: Manny Aulakh only started playing cricket with a hard ball just three years ago, but featured in all of Canada's matches at the 2010 Under-19 World Cup Qualifiers, picking up six wickets and ensuring their qualification for the main event. His favourite cricketer is Glenn McGrath, though he compares his style of play to Australia's Shane Watson.
